search_text: published ZDI-22-081 ZDI-CAN-14656 TP-Link TL-WA1201 DNS Response Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2022-01-17 CVE-2021-35004 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-35004 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['TP-Link'] ['TL-WA1201'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WA1201 wireless access points. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of DNS responses. title: TP-Link TL-WA1201 DNS Response Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WA1201 wireless access points. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of DNS responses. A crafted DNS message can trigger an overflow of a fixed-length, stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
